note: Proposed 2026-11-19 from the Ride a Dino colour study (docs/design/colour.md). Each land copies the values of its nearest reference land, kept in our own hue where our land has one. floor: the ground and wall tops; face: wall sides; fog: the water's colour (what the distance fades to); props: main pair (light, dark) and accent; glow: the land's own light (from land 6). Not in the game. fog_halfway: the user's pick (2026-11-19, "Halfway"): each land's water hue as today at half its strength (at least 0.3; the dark ones, under L* 55, at three quarters and at least 0.5, as halved they went grey), its lightness half way between today's and the pale proposal's. 2026-11-19: the deep lands' fog lifted in lightness by mixing toward white (hue kept, a little softer) and Midnight's and the Underworld's floors a little lighter, after the value study (docs/design/colour.md, "Value").
